'''Giancarlo Ghirardi''' (28 October 1935 – 1 June 2018)<ref name="Bassi2018a">{{cite journal
 | author = Angelo Bassi, Tullio Weber, Detlef Dürr
 | title = GianCarlo Ghirardi
 | journal = Physics Today
 | volume = 71
 | issue = 10
 | page = 60
 | year = 2018
 | doi = 10.1063/PT.3.4050
| bibcode = 2018PhT....71j..60B
 | doi-access = free
 }}</ref><ref name="Bassi2018b">{{cite journal
 | author = Angelo Bassi
 | title = Giancarlo Ghirardi
 | journal = Nature Physics
 | volume = 14
 | issue = 8
 | page = 774
 | year = 2018
 | doi = 10.1038/s41567-018-0249-y
| bibcode = 2018NatPh..14..774B
 | doi-access = free
 }}</ref> was an Italian [[physicist]] and [[emeritus professor]] of [[theoretical physics]] at the [[University of Trieste]].

He is well known for the [[Ghirardi–Rimini–Weber theory]] (GRW), which he proposed in 1985 together with Alberto Rimini and Tullio Weber,<ref name="Ghirardi1985">{{cite book
 | author = Giancarlo Ghirardi, Alberto Rimini, Tullio Weber
 | title = Quantum Probability and Applications II
 | chapter = A model for a unified quantum description of macroscopic and microscopic systems
 | series = Lecture Notes in Mathematics
 | volume = 1136
 | pages = 223–232
 | year = 1985
 | doi = 10.1007/bfb0074474
| isbn = 978-3-540-15661-1
 | bibcode = 1985LNM..1136..223G
 }}</ref><ref name="Ghirardi1986">{{cite journal
 | author = Giancarlo Ghirardi, Alberto Rimini, Tullio Weber
 | title = Unified dynamics for microscopic and macroscopic systems
 | journal = Physical Review D
 | volume = 34
 | issue = 2
 | pages = 470–491
 | year = 1986
 | doi = 10.1103/PhysRevD.34.470
 | pmid = 9957165
 |bibcode = 1986PhRvD..34..470G
}}</ref> and for his contributions to the [[quantum foundations|foundations]] of [[quantum mechanics]]. He independently rederived, in a referee report to ''Foundations of Physics'', the [[no-cloning theorem]], before the works by [[William Wootters]] and [[Wojciech H. Zurek]]<ref name="wootterszurek">{{cite journal
 | last1 = Wootters | first1 = William 
 | last2 = Zurek| first2 = Wojciech 
 | year = 1982
 | title = A single quantum cannot be cloned
 | journal = [[Nature (journal)|Nature]]
 | volume = 299 | issue = 5886 
 | pages = 802–803
 |bibcode = 1982Natur.299..802W |doi = 10.1038/299802a0 | s2cid = 4339227 
 }}</ref> and by [[Dennis Dieks]]<ref name = "dieks">{{cite journal
 | last = Dieks| first = Dennis
 | year = 1982
 | title = Communication by EPR devices
 | journal = [[Physics Letters A]]
 | volume = 92 | issue = 6 | pages = 271–272
 |bibcode = 1982PhLA...92..271D |doi = 10.1016/0375-9601(82)90084-6 | hdl = 1874/16932
 | hdl-access = free
 }}</ref> in 1982,
but after the actual first derivation by James L. Park<ref name="park">{{cite journal
 | last1 = Park | first1 = James
 | year = 1970
 | title = The concept of transition in quantum mechanics
 | journal = [[Foundations of Physics]]
 | volume = 1 | issue = 1
 | pages = 23–33
 |doi = 10.1007/BF00708652 | bibcode = 1970FoPh....1...23P| s2cid = 55890485
 }}</ref> in 1970.

His research interests related to a variety of topics of [[theoretical physics]], but focused beginning in 1983 mainly on the foundations of quantum mechanics.

Ghirardi was a member of the editorial boards of ''[[Foundations of Physics]]'' and ''[[Studies in History and Philosophy of Science]]''. He was president of the Italian Society for the Foundations of Physics, of which he was one of the founding members.<ref>[http://www.fornidisopra.com/?p=1184 Giancarlo Ghirardi] (in Italian)</ref>

The President of the Province of [[Trieste]], [[Maria Teresa Bassa Poropat]], conferred the ''Sigillo della Provincia di Trieste'' to Giancarlo Ghirardi for research and teaching, for his commitment to the promotion and development of physics in Trieste and for his intense and fruitful activity as the author of popular books and scientific publications.

In 2017, he was awarded the ''Spirit of Salam'' prize for his extraordinary contributions to the development of the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] during its budding years, both at its scientific and organizational fronts.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/media-centre/news/2017/1/spirit-salam-awards-2017.aspx | title=ICTP - Salam Spirit Awardees Announced}}</ref>
